description: Source code for the mod_wstunnel module in lighttpd, implementing WebSocket tunneling with support for different WebSocket protocol versions, including handshake handling, frame processing, and proxying logic.

classes.name: plugin_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for wstunnel plugin, including server extensions, frame type, and ping interval.

classes.name: plugin_data
classes.description: Main plugin data structure, including defaults and runtime state.

classes.name: handler_ctx
classes.description: Context for handling individual WebSocket tunnel connections, including protocol version, frame state, and configuration.

classes.name: mod_wstunnel_frame_t
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket frame, including type, control info, and payload buffer.

classes.name: mod_wstunnel_frame_control_t
classes.description: Control information for WebSocket frames, such as size and masking.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_init
methods.description: Initializes plugin data structure.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges individual configuration values into plugin config.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration values.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration patches based on request context.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration for the plugin.

methods.name: wstunnel_create_env
methods.description: Creates WebSocket environment for a connection, handling handshake and protocol setup.

methods.name: wstunnel_stdin_append
methods.description: Prepares WebSocket frames to send to backend.

methods.name: wstunnel_recv_parse
methods.description: Parses data received from backend WebSocket connection.

methods.name: wstunnel_is_allowed_origin
methods.description: Checks if the request origin is allowed based on configuration.

methods.name: wstunnel_check_request
methods.description: Validates WebSocket upgrade request headers.

methods.name: wstunnel_backend_error
methods.description: Handles backend connection errors by sending close frames.

methods.name: wstunnel_handler_ctx_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with connection handler context.

methods.name: wstunnel_handler_setup
methods.description: Sets up connection handler context, including handshake and protocol version.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_check_extension
methods.description: Checks if request is a WebSocket upgrade request and initiates handshake.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_handle_trigger
methods.description: Periodic trigger to handle timeouts, pings, and connection cleanup.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_plugin_init
methods.description: Registers the plugin with lighttpd.

methods.name: create_response_rfc_6455
methods.description: Creates WebSocket handshake response for RFC 6455 version.

methods.name: create_response_ietf_00
methods.description: Creates WebSocket handshake response for draft-ietf-hybi-00 version.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_handshake_create_response
methods.description: Handles WebSocket handshake response creation based on protocol version.

methods.name: send_rfc_6455
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket frame using RFC 6455 framing.

methods.name: send_ietf_00
methods.description: Sends a WebSocket frame using draft-ietf-hybi-00 framing.

methods.name: recv_rfc_6455
methods.description: Receives and processes WebSocket frames using RFC 6455 framing.

methods.name: recv_ietf_00
methods.description: Receives and processes WebSocket frames using draft-ietf-hybi-00 framing.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_frame_send
methods.description: Dispatches frame sending based on protocol version.

methods.name: mod_wstunnel_frame_recv
methods.description: Dispatches frame receiving based on protocol version.
